sources.title: 京张铁路历史背景资料（网络百科条目）
sources.citation: Wikipedia contributors, "Beijing-Zhangjiakou Railway", Wikipedia, The Free Encyclopedia, accessed 2026-08. Encyclopedic background only; heritage interpretations require authentication by cultural heritage authorities.
sources.usage_note: Background context for the Beijing-Zhangjiakou Railway route, stations, and cultural significance along the AI belt corridor. Not used as formal planning evidence.
sources.risk_note: Encyclopedia content may change over time and is not an archival source. The printed reference (詹天佑纪念馆《京张铁路百年史》, 中国铁道出版社, 2006) mentioned in earlier versions has no public URL and is therefore not registered here; heritage claims require authentication by cultural heritage authorities.

sources.title: Jacquard Loom Historical Reference
sources.publisher: Musée des Arts et Métiers, Paris
sources.citation: Musée des Arts et Métiers, The Jacquard Loom: A History of Programmable Weaving, 2010.
sources.usage_note: Historical reference for the Jacquard loom as metaphor for AI-driven urban weaving; pattern-card programming as analogy for AI scenario orchestration.
sources.risk_note: Used as design metaphor; the Jacquard governance protocol is a conceptual proposal, not a historical practice.

sources.title: 三区两翼打造世界级AI集聚地
sources.publisher: 北京市科学技术委员会、中关村科技园区管理委员会网站
sources.citation: 北京市科学技术委员会、中关村科技园区管理委员会网站：《三区两翼打造世界级AI集聚地》，2026-04-03。
sources.usage_note: Background reference for the official "Three Zones, Two Wings" spatial structure (Xuebeiyuan / AI Origin Community / Dazhongsi plus the Zhongguancun Sci-Tech Service Wing and Xiaoyuehe Scenario-Empowerment Wing) and its reported ~37 km2 scale. Used only for structural alignment in proposal Section 3.5 and regional collaboration in Section 9.5.
sources.risk_note: Official web article is policy-communication wording, not a statutory plan or boundary. The ~37 km2 figure differs from the taskbook 43.6 km2 scale due to boundary demarcation; this proposal always recomputes from the taskbook tiers and provisional boundary.

sources.title: "三城一区"专题页

sources.risk_note: Official topic page reflects current policy communication; collaboration directions listed in the proposal are conceptual and non-binding.

sources.title: 阔步迈向全球AI产业高地！海淀打造"两区一带"人工智能创新街区

sources.usage_note: Background reference for Haidian's "Two Zones, One Belt" AI innovation street (AI Origin Community and Zhongguancun AI Beiwai Community linked by the Jingzhang Railway Heritage Park green belt), cited in proposal Section 9.5 as the north-side regional counterpart.
sources.risk_note: Media reporting of district-level plans; not a statutory plan. The Beiwai Community lies outside the proposal site boundary and is referenced as a coordination counterpart only.
